pagesetup.title: Page setup
pagesetup.sub: Paper size, orientation and margins. Body text boxes and tables follow the margins; other objects stay where they are.
pagesetup.headerTip: Distance from the top edge of the paper to the header
pagesetup.footerTip: Distance from the bottom edge of the paper to the footer
pagesetup.scopePageNote: A page with its own setup becomes a section of its own when saved as DOCX or HWPX, which change paper only at section breaks.
pagesetup.tooSmall: The margins leave no room for the body.
pagesetup.noReflow: Body text that no longer fits runs past the bottom margin; it is not moved to the next page automatically.
pagesetup.toast.pageBreak: Page break inserted: the text after the cursor and the objects below moved to a new page.
pagesetup.toast.sectionBreak: Section break inserted: the new section can have its own paper in Page setup.
pagesetup.toast.noPage: There is no page to set up.
table.rangeHint: Click a cell, Shift+click another to select a range, then merge.
table.toast.needRange: Select the cells to merge first: click a cell, then Shift+click another.
table.toast.split: The cell was split into two columns.
table.toast.unmerged: The merged cell was split back into its cells.
